short_description: A full technical analysis report card: multi-timeframe trend, support/resistance, moving averages, RSI/MACD/Bollinger, volume, chart patterns, Fibonacci levels, entry/stop/target, risk-reward and a rating.
skill_description: Produces a technical analysis report card and trade-plan summary for a stock: trend on daily/weekly/monthly timeframes, key support and resistance price levels, 50/100/200-day moving averages and crossovers, RSI, MACD and Bollinger Band readings in plain English, volume trend (buyer vs seller strength), chart pattern identification, Fibonacci retracement levels, ideal entry, stop-loss and profit target, risk-to-reward ratio, and a rating from strong buy to strong sell. Best with an uploaded OHLCV price CSV; otherwise uses sourced indicator data. Use when the user asks about a chart, technicals, support/resistance, entry or exit levels, or timing a trade.
